why: Top row: curved X with closed petals -> curved X with open lines. Right column: curved lines become straight lines. So the missing figure is a straight X that is closed by an outline, just as the petals close the curved X. Option 3 (X inside a square) fits. Option 2 is only the open X, which is already in the bottom right.
trick: In a 2x2 grid, read the change across a row and down a column; the missing cell must follow both.
